title: SessionSnapshot@1 payload
description: The content-addressed transcript of one Attempt's harness session, captured at seal through the two-phase protocol and re-materialized for a forked resume. The session identity is assigned by the kernel from the Attempt ID before the harness starts, never chosen by the provider, so a kernel that crashed after capture can still find the exact transcript it owes a deletion. The snapshot is node-private: only the next Attempt of the same node may resume it, and only with a fork, so the captured bytes are never mutated. The source names the adapter kind and the content identity of the harness path; a host path never enters a durable record.

transcript_artifact_id.description: The raw transcript bytes in the CAS. Re-materialized into the next Attempt's harness directory before a forked resume.

estimated_tokens.description: What the transcript is expected to cost as input on resume, gated against the next Attempt's reservation beside the delta prompt.

session_id.description: The kernel-assigned session identity: the Attempt's Round-scoped hex ID followed by a fixed suffix, in the canonical 8-4-4-4-12 shape the pinned CLI accepts for --session-id.

path_digest.description: Content identity of the harness path the transcript was captured from. Never the path itself.
